ei.title: 브랜드화의 역할: 인지도를 통한 소비자의 위험 감소
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, (A)[confusion / recognition] is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be (B)[comfortable / anxious] with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation (C)[reduces / increases] the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 인지(recognition), (B) 편안한(comfortable), (C) 줄이다(reduces) — 세 자리 모두 원문 단어가 문맥에 맞다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① confusion(혼란)은 '고객 입장에서 중요한 특징'이라는 흐름과 반대 (원문 recognition)

❌ ② anxious(불안한)는 브랜드에 익숙해져 '편안해진다'는 흐름과 정반대 (원문 comfortable)

✅ ③ recognition — comfortable — reduces: 세 단어 모두 원문과 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ increases(늘리다)는 기대가 위험을 '줄인다'는 문맥과 반대 (원문 reduces)
det.tip: recognition(인지), comfortable(편안한), reduce(줄이다) — 글 전체가 '인지 → 편안함 → 위험 감소' 흐름

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise (A)[unfamiliar / preferred] (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are (B)[globally / locally] recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or (C)[additional / reduced] comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 선호되는(preferred), (B) 전 세계적으로(globally), (C) 추가적인(additional) — 세 자리 모두 원문 단어.
det.analysis:
✅ ① preferred — globally — additional: 세 단어 모두 원문과 일치 ←정답

❌ ② unfamiliar(낯선)는 고객이 '선호하는' 브랜드를 알아본다는 문맥과 어긋남 (원문 preferred)

❌ ③ locally(지역적으로)는 '전 세계적으로' 인지된 호텔이라는 문맥과 반대 (원문 globally)

❌ ④ reduced(줄어든)는 '추가적인' 편안함이라는 문맥과 반대 (원문 additional)
det.tip: preferred(선호되는), globally(전 세계적으로), additional(추가적인)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an (A)[trivial / important] feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good (B)[indication / doubt] of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will (C)[deliver / withhold] a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 중요한(important), (B) 짐작/암시(indication), (C) 제공하다(deliver) — 세 자리 모두 원문 단어.
det.analysis:
❌ ① trivial(사소한)은 인지가 '중요한' 특징이라는 문맥과 반대 (원문 important)

❌ ② doubt(의심)은 무엇을 기대할지 '좋은 짐작'을 갖는다는 문맥과 어긋남 (원문 indication)

❌ ③ withhold(주지 않다)는 서비스를 '제공하겠다'는 브랜드 약속과 정반대 (원문 deliver)

✅ ④ important — indication — deliver: 세 단어 모두 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: important(중요한), indication(짐작·암시), deliver(제공하다)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, ①<u>recognition</u> is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be ②<u>uneasy</u> with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or ③<u>additional comfort</u> but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation ④<u>reduces the risk</u> of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 comfortable(편안한)인데 uneasy(불안한)로 바꿈. 브랜드를 경험하면 그 브랜드에 '편안해진다'는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① recognition(인지): 고객 입장에서 '인지'가 중요한 특징이라는 맥락에 적절

❌ ② uneasy(불안한) → comfortable(편안한): 브랜드를 경험하고 나면 그 브랜드에 '편안해진다'는 문맥이므로 uneasy는 정반대 ←정답

✅ ③ additional comfort(추가적인 편안함): 더 나은 가치나 '추가적인 편안함' 때문이 아니라는 맥락에 적절

✅ ④ reduces the risk(위험을 줄이다): 기대가 위험을 '줄인다'는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: comfortable(편안한) ↔ uneasy(불안한)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both ①<u>benefit</u> from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are ②<u>globally recognised</u>. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a ③<u>vague indication</u> of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any ④<u>unpleasant</u> surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 good(좋은)인데 vague(모호한)로 바꿈. 여행자가 무엇을 기대할지 '좋은(분명한) 짐작'을 갖는다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefit(이득을 얻다): 고객과 기업 모두 브랜드화에서 '이득을 얻는다'는 맥락에 적절

✅ ② globally recognised(전 세계적으로 인지된): 세계적으로 '인지된' 호텔 체인이라는 맥락에 적절

❌ ③ vague indication(모호한 짐작) → good indication(좋은 짐작): 여행자가 무엇을 기대할지 '분명한' 짐작을 갖기에 위험이 준다는 문맥이므로 vague는 부적절 ←정답

✅ ④ unpleasant(불쾌한): 여행 중 '불쾌한' 놀라움의 위험이라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: good indication(분명한 짐작) ↔ vague(모호한)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise ①<u>preferred</u> (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower ②<u>perceived risk</u>. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or ③<u>additional comfort</u> but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would ④<u>recognise locally</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 worldwide(전 세계적으로)인데 locally(지역적으로)로 바꿈. 전 세계 소비자가 알아볼 수준의 서비스라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① preferred(선호되는): 고객이 '선호하는' 브랜드를 알아본다는 맥락에 적절

✅ ② perceived risk(인지된 위험): 브랜드에 편안해지면 '인지된 위험'이 낮아진다는 맥락에 적절

✅ ③ additional comfort(추가적인 편안함): '추가적인 편안함' 때문이 아니라는 맥락에 적절

❌ ④ recognise locally(지역적으로 알아보다) → recognise worldwide(전 세계적으로 알아보다): 소비자가 '전 세계에서' 알아볼 서비스를 제공한다는 문맥이므로 locally는 정반대 ←정답
det.tip: worldwide(전 세계적으로) ↔ locally(지역적으로)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived __________. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 위험(risk). 브랜드에 익숙해지면 인지된 '위험'이 낮아지는 경향이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① risk(위험): 브랜드에 편안해지면 '인지된 위험'이 낮아진다는 흐름에 적절. 뒤에서도 '위험을 줄인다'가 반복됨 ←정답

❌ ② reward(보상): 위험 감소가 아니라 보상이라 문맥과 어긋남

❌ ③ price(가격): 이 부분은 가격이 아니라 심리적 위험을 다룸

❌ ④ speed(속도): 속도는 글에서 다루지 않음
det.tip: lower perceived risk = 인지된 위험을 낮추다. 뒤 문장 reduces the risk와 연결

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to __________ from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기대하다(expect). 여행자는 어느 지점에서든 무엇을 '기대할지'에 대한 좋은 짐작을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid(피하다): '무엇을 피할지'가 아니라 '무엇을 기대할지'가 핵심

✅ ② expect(기대하다): 여행자가 '무엇을 기대할지'에 대한 좋은 짐작을 갖기에 위험이 준다는 문맥에 적절 ←정답

❌ ③ forget(잊다): 문맥과 무관

❌ ④ pay(지불하다): 지불이 아니라 기대에 관한 내용
det.tip: a good indication of what to expect = 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 좋은 짐작

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant __________ during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 놀라움(surprises). 브랜드에 대한 기대는 여행 중 불쾌한 '놀라움'의 위험을 줄인다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① rewards(보상): '불쾌한 보상'은 어색하고 문맥과 안 맞음

❌ ② delays(지연): 지연은 글에서 언급되지 않음

✅ ③ surprises(놀라움): '불쾌한 놀라움(뜻밖의 일)'의 위험을 줄인다는 문맥에 적절 ←정답

❌ ④ costs(비용): 비용이 아니라 예상치 못한 일에 관한 내용
det.tip: unpleasant surprises = 불쾌한 놀라움(예상 못 한 나쁜 일)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both <u>benefit</u> from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>benefit</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: benefit = gain = 이득을 얻다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① gain(이득을 얻다): 고객과 기업 모두 브랜드화에서 '이득을 얻는다'는 문맥에서 benefit의 동의어로 적절 ←정답

❌ ② lose(잃다): benefit의 반대 방향 의미

❌ ③ delay(지연시키다): 시간과 관련된 말로 무관

❌ ④ hide(숨기다): 의미가 전혀 다름
det.tip: benefit from ~ = ~에서 이득을 얻다 = gain from ~

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This <u>expectation</u> reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>expectation</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: expectation = anticipation = 기대, 예상.
det.analysis:
❌ ① memory(기억): 과거를 떠올리는 말로 '기대'와 다름

✅ ② anticipation(기대·예상): 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 '기대'가 위험을 줄인다는 문맥에서 expectation의 동의어로 적절 ←정답

❌ ③ distance(거리): 거리와 관련된 말로 무관

❌ ④ refusal(거절): 거절은 의미가 전혀 다름
det.tip: expectation = anticipation = 기대, 예상

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>indication</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: indication = sign = 짐작, 암시, 표시.
det.analysis:
❌ ① threat(위협): 위험을 뜻하는 말로 '짐작'과 다름

❌ ② reward(보상): 보상은 의미가 무관

❌ ③ delay(지연): 시간과 관련된 말로 무관

✅ ④ sign(표시·조짐): 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 '짐작·표시'라는 문맥에서 indication의 동의어로 적절 ←정답
det.tip: indication = sign = 짐작, 암시, 조짐

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to <u>lower</u> perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>lower</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: lower(낮추다) ↔ raise(높이다).
det.analysis:
✅ ① raise(높이다·올리다): 위험을 '낮추다(lower)'의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답

❌ ② reduce(줄이다): lower의 유의어라 반의어가 아님

❌ ③ expect(기대하다): 의미축이 전혀 다른 단어

❌ ④ travel(여행하다): 의미축이 전혀 다른 단어
det.tip: lower(낮추다) ↔ raise(높이다). reduce는 오히려 비슷한 말

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are <u>globally</u> recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>globally</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: globally(전 세계적으로) ↔ locally(지역적으로).
det.analysis:
❌ ① widely(널리): globally와 비슷한 방향의 말이라 반의어가 아님

✅ ② locally(지역적으로): '전 세계적으로(globally)'의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답

❌ ③ nearby(가까이): 거리를 뜻하는 말로 의미축이 다름

❌ ④ openly(공개적으로): 방식을 뜻하는 말로 의미축이 다름
det.tip: globally(전 세계적으로) ↔ locally(지역적으로). widely는 오히려 비슷한 말

questions.passage:
(A) A good hotel is judged by the <u>service</u> its staff provide to every guest. Travellers often return to a brand that offers reliable <u>service</u> worldwide.

(B) After graduation, he spent two years in military <u>service</u> abroad. Many young men complete their national <u>service</u> before starting a career.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 service의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 service는 '서비스(응대)', (B)의 service는 '복무(군 복무)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 서비스 — (B) 복무: (A)는 호텔 직원이 제공하는 '서비스(응대)', (B)는 군에서의 '복무'를 뜻함 ←정답

❌ ② (A) 복무 — (B) 서비스: (A)와 (B)의 뜻이 서로 뒤바뀜

❌ ③ (B)가 '예배'가 아니라 '복무'

❌ ④ (A)가 '수리'가 아니라 '서비스'
det.tip: service: '서비스(응대)', '복무', '예배' 등 다의어 — 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the activity of giving a company or product a name and design so that people can recognise it"

det.korean: branding = 브랜드화 (사람들이 알아볼 수 있도록 회사·제품에 이름과 디자인을 부여하는 활동)
det.analysis:
❌ ① packaging(포장): '포장'을 뜻하는 말로 정의와 불일치

✅ ② branding(브랜드화): '사람들이 알아볼 수 있도록 회사·제품에 이름과 디자인을 부여하는 활동'이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답

❌ ③ shipping(배송): '배송'을 뜻하는 말로 정의와 불일치

❌ ④ pricing(가격 책정): '가격 책정'을 뜻하는 말로 정의와 불일치
det.tip: branding = 브랜드화 (알아볼 수 있게 이름·디자인을 부여하는 것)

questions.passage: For the consumer, once they have __________ (experience) the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand. This tends to lower perceived risk.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

experience → ____

det.korean: 'have + 과거분사'의 현재완료이므로 experience를 과거분사 experienced로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 have가 있어요. 'have + 과거분사(p.p.)'는 '~해 본 적이 있다/이미 ~했다'를 나타내는 현재완료예요. 그래서 동사 experience에 -d를 붙여 experienced로 바꿔야 해요. 'once they have experienced the brand(일단 그 브랜드를 경험하고 나면)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: have + 과거분사 = 현재완료. experience → experienced

questions.passage: This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value. It is because the traveller has a good __________ (indicate) of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

indicate → ____

det.korean: 관사 a와 형용사 good의 수식을 받고 전치사 of 앞에 오는 명사 자리이므로 명사형 indication으로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 'a good(하나의 좋은)'이 있어요. 관사 a와 형용사 good의 꾸밈을 받으려면 명사가 와야 하죠. 그래서 동사 indicate를 명사형 indication으로 바꿔 'a good indication of ~(~에 대한 좋은 짐작)'을 만들어요.
det.tip: 동사 indicate → 명사 indication. 관사(a)+형용사(good) 뒤에는 명사

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer __________ but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 더 나은 가치나 추가적인 편안함(better value or additional comfort). 브랜드 호텔을 택하는 것은 반드시 이것 때문은 아니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a written guarantee of safety(안전에 대한 서면 보증): 글에서 다루지 않는 내용

❌ ② the lowest possible price(가능한 가장 낮은 가격): '가장 낮은 가격'이라는 극단적 표현은 본문에 없음

✅ ③ better value or additional comfort(더 나은 가치나 추가적인 편안함): 뒤에 'but because(하지만 ~때문이다)'로 이어지며, 브랜드 호텔 선택이 반드시 이것 때문은 아니라는 대비 구조에 부합 ←정답

❌ ④ free travel insurance(무료 여행 보험): 글에 등장하지 않는 소재
det.tip: not necessarily because A but because B 구조 → A = 더 나은 가치·추가적 편안함

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of __________ worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어느 지점에서든 무엇을 기대할지(what to expect from any of their hotels). 여행자는 이에 대한 좋은 짐작을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① how to book a cheaper room online(온라인으로 더 싼 방을 예약하는 법): 예약 방법은 글의 논지와 무관

❌ ② which local restaurants they should visit(어떤 현지 식당을 방문해야 할지): 식당은 본문에 없음

❌ ③ when the next available flight departs(다음 항공편이 언제 출발하는지): 항공편은 본문에 없음

✅ ④ what to expect from any of their hotels(어느 지점에서든 무엇을 기대할지): 여행자가 브랜드 호텔에 대해 갖는 '좋은 짐작'의 내용으로, 뒤 문장의 '기대(expectation)'와 연결됨 ←정답
det.tip: a good indication of ___ → 무엇을 기대할지(what to expect)에 대한 짐작
